item.title: Important step to boost level crossing safety in Tawa
item.description: There was a fatality at the crossing at McLellan St in 2020, as well as nine near misses over the past 15 years. An “important step” has been taken to improve level crossing safety in Tawa, Wellington with the opening of new automatic pedestrian gates at McLellan Street. The four new gates are activated by a sensor on the tracks and have a safety zone with an emergency exit gate.
